supporting_observations.claim: The available network records show seven connections from WS-LMARTINS-01 (10.40.10.22) to the internal proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 between 13:35:56 and 14:05:48 UTC. The gaps are approximately 4 minutes 19 seconds to 5 minutes 29 seconds.
The observed cadence is consistent with the inventoried PixelForge updater's approximately five-minute update checks, but these records do not identify the application making the connections.
The Zeek records describe connections to the internal proxy on port 8080; they do not show the external destination or establish the HTTPS request's contents.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available connection records do not include proxy request details such as the CONNECT target, URL, or external host, so the destination cannot be verified (T036-00101, T036-00144, T036-00178, T036-00208, T036-00235, T036-00242, T036-00256).

The connection records do not identify the originating process or executable, so they cannot confirm that PixelForge's approved updater generated the traffic (T036-00101, T036-00144, T036-00178, T036-00208, T036-00235, T036-00242, T036-00256).
The supplied records show connections beginning at 13:35:56 UTC; they do not provide direct records for the entire alert interval or establish what happened at each roughly five-minute point.
claims_not_established: Whether the connections went to updates.pixelforge-suite.com or another destination.
Whether pfupdater.exe, or an unapproved process, initiated the connections.
Whether the traffic was benign update checking or malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-NWD-01 request/access logs for the observed times, including CONNECT targets, destination hostnames, response codes, and byte counts.
Endpoint network/process telemetry correlating each connection with its originating process, command line, user, and executable path.
If the process is identified as pfupdater.exe, verify its signature and file hash against the approved PixelForge installation.
unrelated_findings: Separate review may be warranted for a WmiPrvSE.exe-to-svchost.exe process-access event on WS-LMARTINS-01; the record alone does not establish malicious behavior (T036-00047).
A DC log records an ANONYMOUS LOGON SMB session from WS-LMARTINS-01; this is outside the alerted proxy activity and is not assessed here (T036-00037).
